dialogue.text: In London, suicide terrorist bombings strike three underground stations and a double-decker buzz.
dialogue.zh: 在倫敦，自殺式恐怖炸彈襲擊了三個地鐵站和一輛雙層巴士。
dialogue.ja: ロンドンで、自爆テロが地下鉄の3駅と二階建てバスを襲いました。
dialogue.local: In London, suicide terrorist bombings strike three underground stations and a double-decker buzz.
dialogue.en: In London, suicide terrorist bombings strike three underground stations and a double-decker buzz.

dialogue.text: The blasts kill 52 victims and four bombers in the worst attack on the British capital since World War II.
dialogue.zh: 這些爆炸造成52名受害者和4名炸彈客死亡，是二戰以來對英國首都最嚴重的攻擊。
dialogue.ja: この爆発で52人の犠牲者と4人の爆弾犯が死亡し、第二次世界大戦以来最悪の英国首都への攻撃となりました。
dialogue.local: The blasts kill 52 victims and four bombers in the worst attack on the British capital since World War II.
dialogue.en: The blasts kill 52 victims and four bombers in the worst attack on the British capital since World War II.

dialogue.text: 1865, in Washington, four people are hanged for conspiring with John Wilkes Booth to assassinate President Abraham Lincoln.
dialogue.zh: 1865年，在華盛頓，四人因與約翰·威爾克斯·布斯密謀暗殺總統亞伯拉罕·林肯而被絞死。
dialogue.ja: 1865年、ワシントンで、ジョン・ウィルクス・ブースと共謀してエイブラハム・リンカーン大統領を暗殺しようとした4人が絞首刑に処されました。
dialogue.local: 1865, in Washington, four people are hanged for conspiring with John Wilkes Booth to assassinate President Abraham Lincoln.
dialogue.en: 1865, in Washington, four people are hanged for conspiring with John Wilkes Booth to assassinate President Abraham Lincoln.

dialogue.text: I came here to tell you the truth, to tell you in this committee and the American people the truth.
dialogue.zh: 我來這裡是要告訴你們真相，向這個委員會和美國人民說出真相。
dialogue.ja: 私はここに真実を伝えるために来ました。この委員会とアメリカ国民に真実を伝えるためです。
dialogue.local: I came here to tell you the truth, to tell you in this committee and the American people the truth.
dialogue.en: I came here to tell you the truth, to tell you in this committee and the American people the truth.

dialogue.text: Also in Washington, Lieutenant Colonel Oliver North begins his public testimony at Congressional hearings on the Iran-Contra affair, the former Reagan White House aide at the heart of the arms for hostages scandal says he never carried out a single act without authorization.
dialogue.zh: 同樣在華盛頓，中校奧利弗·諾斯開始在國會聽證會上公開作證，這位前雷根白宮助理是人質換武器醜聞的核心，他表示從未在未經授權下執行任何行動。
dialogue.ja: 同じくワシントンで、オリバー・ノース中佐がイラン・コントラ事件に関する議会公聴会で公の証言を開始しました。元レーガン政権のホワイトハウス補佐官であり、人質と武器の取引スキャンダルの中心人物は、許可なく行動したことは一度もないと述べています。
dialogue.local: Also in Washington, Lieutenant Colonel Oliver North begins his public testimony at Congressional hearings on the Iran-Contra affair, the former Reagan White House aide at the heart of the arms for hostages scandal says he never carried out a single act without authorization.
dialogue.en: Also in Washington, Lieutenant Colonel Oliver North begins his public testimony at Congressional hearings on the Iran-Contra affair, the former Reagan White House aide at the heart of the arms for hostages scandal says he never carried out a single act without authorization.

dialogue.text: 1981, President Ronald Reagan dominates Sandra Day O'Connor and Arizona Judge to be the first female justice on the U.S. Supreme Court.
dialogue.zh: 1981年，總統羅納德·雷根任命亞利桑那州法官桑德拉·戴·奧康納成為美國最高法院首位女性大法官。
dialogue.ja: 1981年、ロナルド・レーガン大統領はアリゾナ州の判事サンドラ・デイ・オコナーを米国最高裁判所の初の女性判事に任命しました。
dialogue.local: 1981, President Ronald Reagan dominates Sandra Day O'Connor and Arizona Judge to be the first female justice on the U.S. Supreme Court.
dialogue.en: 1981, President Ronald Reagan dominates Sandra Day O'Connor and Arizona Judge to be the first female justice on the U.S. Supreme Court.

dialogue.text: Robert Heinlein, the science fiction writer whose works include Stranger in a Strange Land, is born in Butler, Missouri, and 1940.
dialogue.zh: 科幻作家羅伯特·海萊因，作品包括《異鄉異客》，出生於密蘇里州巴特勒，1940年。
dialogue.ja: SF作家ロバート・ハインラインは、『未知の異郷人』などの作品で知られ、ミズーリ州バトラーで生まれました。1940年です。
dialogue.local: Robert Heinlein, the science fiction writer whose works include Stranger in a Strange Land, is born in Butler, Missouri, and 1940.
dialogue.en: Robert Heinlein, the science fiction writer whose works include Stranger in a Strange Land, is born in Butler, Missouri, and 1940.

dialogue.text: In addition, Ringo Starr, the drummer in the rock band The Beatles, is born Richard Starkey in Liverpool, England.
dialogue.zh: 此外，搖滾樂隊披頭四的鼓手林戈·斯塔爾，本名理查德·斯塔基，出生於英格蘭利物浦。
dialogue.ja: さらに、ロックバンド「ビートルズ」のドラマー、リンゴ・スターは本名リチャード・スターキーとしてイングランドのリバプールで生まれました。
dialogue.local: In addition, Ringo Starr, the drummer in the rock band The Beatles, is born Richard Starkey in Liverpool, England.
dialogue.en: In addition, Ringo Starr, the drummer in the rock band The Beatles, is born Richard Starkey in Liverpool, England.

dialogue.text: Today in history, July 7th, Mike Grossia, the Associated Press.
dialogue.zh: 歷史上的今天，7月7日，美聯社記者邁克·格羅西亞報導。
dialogue.ja: 今日は歴史上の7月7日です。AP通信のマイク・グロシアがお伝えします。
dialogue.local: Today in history, July 7th, Mike Grossia, the Associated Press.
dialogue.en: Today in history, July 7th, Mike Grossia, the Associated Press.
